title.zh: 复盘：陪下一步，也给独自尝试留空间
title.en: Review company with room to try alone

paragraphs.zh: 沿用纸板模型，分别想一个“并排试一次”和“我先自己试”的版本。陪伴可以只是递一张纸、比较一步，不必替别人完成；对方想安静时也不用把拒绝读成疏远。可以只画下一步。复盘看帮助是否被需要、范围是否符合双方时间，不以付出多少判断善良或忠诚。
paragraphs.en: For the cardboard model, imagine trying one step together and trying alone first. Company might mean passing paper or comparing one step without finishing the work for someone. A preference for quiet need not mean distance. Sketch only the next step. Review wanted help and time limits for both people without grading goodness or loyalty through how much was given.

title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined craft task

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友在做纸板模型，你会怎样提出只陪下一步，又让对方能自在地说想自己试？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend were making a cardboard model, how would you offer company for one step while leaving room to try alone?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：选定承诺，也说清怎样改约
title.en: Review a commitment and how to revise it

paragraphs.zh: 沿用同一下午的两个项目，给愿接的一项写“做什么、到哪里停、何时回看”，再想时间临时减少时怎样通知。可只改一张虚构分工卡，不必接真实任务。复盘看别人能否据此安排下一步，而非你是否挑了最难的部分；选择较小范围或都不接，不表示责任心较低。
paragraphs.en: For two projects on one afternoon, state the action, stopping point and check-in for one offer, then imagine less time becoming available. Revise a fictional task card without accepting real work. Review whether others can plan the next step rather than whether you chose the hardest part. A smaller offer or declining both does not establish less responsibility.

title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined craft task

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果两个兴趣项目同时邀你帮忙，你会怎样约清愿接的一小部分，以及时间变化后的通知办法？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If two hobby projects asked for help, how would you agree a small contribution and a way to report changed availability?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：保留的细节与可调整处都具体
title.en: Review a chosen detail alongside room to adapt

paragraphs.zh: 沿用共同笔记本封面，标一个想保留的个人细节和一个愿调整的部分，再请伙伴也标一组。若两者冲突，可画两版比较或决定不参与，不必借角色证明谁更真实。只构思也可以。复盘看共同约定和个人贡献是否都能认出，不把赢得设计选择当自信、独立或性别表达的评分。
paragraphs.en: For the shared notebook cover, mark one personal detail to keep and one part open to adaptation, inviting a partner to do the same. Conflicts can lead to two sketches or declining the project without using a character to prove authenticity. Imagine only if preferred. Review the shared agreement and recognisable contributions without grading confidence, independence or gender expression through design victories.

title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined craft task

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果共同封面只能保留一个你喜欢的细节，你会选什么，又愿意在哪一处配合另一种想法？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a shared cover kept one detail you liked, which would it be and where would you adapt to another idea?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：换了例子，究竟清楚了哪一步
title.en: Review what an alternative example actually clarifies

paragraphs.zh: 沿用纸结构的说明，分别起草一个有趣比喻和一个平实步骤，请愿意的人指出各自看懂哪一处。比喻好笑但没帮助，也可放下；对方不用赞赏讲解。可以只自己比较，不必教学。复盘看新例子是否对应任务，而非是否显得聪明；别人更喜欢原方法，不代表缺少想象力。
paragraphs.en: For the paper structure, draft a playful comparison and a plain step, asking a willing person what each clarifies. An amusing but unhelpful comparison can be dropped without applause for the explanation. Compare alone without teaching if preferred. Review correspondence with the task rather than cleverness; preferring the original method establishes no lack of imagination.

title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined craft task

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果同一个纸结构有比喻版和平实版两种说明，你会怎样比较它们各自讲清了什么？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “With a playful comparison and plain instructions for one paper structure, how would you compare what each makes clear?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：再练之前先检查条件
title.en: Review the setup before another attempt

paragraphs.zh: 沿用不顺手的折纸动作，先问说明、纸张和摆放是否合适，再只改一个细节试一轮。若仍不舒服或没兴趣，可休息、换材料或结束，不把坚持当任务。只回看步骤也可以。复盘写具体发生什么，不给自己打毅力分；一次更顺手不证明能力普遍提高，困难也不证明潜力不足。
paragraphs.en: For the awkward paper fold, check the instructions, paper and arrangement before changing one detail for a short attempt. Discomfort or lost interest can lead to a break, different materials or stopping without an obligation to persist. Review steps only if preferred. Describe what happened without grading grit; one smoother attempt establishes no general ability gain, and difficulty no lack of potential.

title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined craft task

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一道折法一直不顺，你会先检查哪个条件，再怎样选一个可以随时停下的小尝试？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a fold remained awkward, which condition would you check and what small, easily stopped attempt would you choose?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：建议、代表和承诺分别说清
title.en: Review a suggestion, representation and promise separately

paragraphs.zh: 沿用项目便条，划出一句建议、一句代表谁的说明和任何承诺。没有得到大家同意，就先写成个人建议；并非每条消息都必须包含三种句子。可以只改虚构草稿，不真正发送。复盘看文字是否符合实际权限与意愿，不追求确保所有人高兴，也不用反复审查每句话来证明体贴。
paragraphs.en: For the project note, mark a suggestion, whom it represents and any promise. Without group agreement, frame it as your own suggestion; a note need not contain all three kinds of statement. Revise a fictional draft without sending it. Review wording against actual agreement and willingness without ensuring everyone’s happiness or repeatedly checking every sentence to prove consideration.

title.en: Discuss choices through an imagined craft task

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一张项目便条容易把个人建议写成全组承诺，你会改哪一句，让读者看清是谁提议、谁已同意？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a project note made a personal suggestion sound like a group promise, which sentence would you change to clarify who suggested and who agreed?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.
